Name: Aurora Vineyard Custom Obelisk
Author: SodaPopReal
Description:
[size=1]Adds both a Warp Obelisk and a Warp Totem to go to the Aurora Vineyard from Stardew Valley Expanded
[/size]

[size=2][b]Warp Totem Recipe:
[/b][/size][spoiler][i]Unlocks at Foraging 4
[/i]1 Hardwood
10 Wood
1 Grape[/spoiler]

[size=2][b]Warp Obelisk Recipe: [/b]
[/size][spoiler]250,000G
5 Iridium Bars
50 Grapes
25 Starfruit[/spoiler]

[b][size=2]Bugs:[/size]
[size=1][u]Using a stack of totems will use all of them at once.[/u]
[/size][/b]Right-clicking on anything in your inventory while holding a totem uses it and teleports you.
